title: Room Reservations Extra-Person Charge Calculation
content:
**Calculation.** The extra-person charge for one night on a Room Reservations reservation is the plan's extra-adult charge for every adult registered beyond the adults the plan's rate covers, on every night of the stay. The new nightly rate is the nightly rate on the reservation plus the extra-person charge for one night, rounded to the cent.

**Quantities.**

1. *Adults beyond those covered* — the adults registered on the reservation less the plan's adults covered by the nightly rate, never below zero.
2. *Adults charged* — those adults beyond the adults covered.
3. *Per-adult charge* — the plan's extra-adult charge per night.
4. *Extra-person charge for one night* — the adults charged multiplied by the per-adult charge.
5. *New nightly rate* — the nightly rate on the reservation plus the extra-person charge for one night, rounded to the cent once, on the new nightly rate.

The plan figures used are the plan's adults covered by the nightly rate and its extra-adult charge per night, as listed for each rate plan in the rate plan schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical reservations)

| Reservation | Adults registered | Adults covered | Adults charged | Extra-adult charge | Extra-person charge for one night | Nightly rate on the reservation | New nightly rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Rate | 3 | 2 | 1 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 229.00 | 254.00 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | 4 | 2 | 2 | 35.00 | 70.00 | 260.00 | 330.00 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | 4 | 2 | 2 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 236.80 | 286.80 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | 3 | 2 | 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 189.00 | 189.00 |
| Member Flexible Rate | 2 | 2 | 0 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 195.30 | 195.30 |

The charge is one night's amount added to the nightly rate, so it is carried on every night of the stay through the nightly rate.
